about: The difficulty's Enemy limits (EnemyLimits, enemy_limits.c): at difficulty 10 the patrol gate goes to 200, the despawn pass off, every other spawn stops at 300 AI enemies, patrols come every 0.5 s with their caps at 1000. Run at difficulty 10 for about 7 minutes (the script's wait) with an immortal Helldiver (research perf-d11's local.perf-seedpin, HELLFORGE_PERF_IMMORTAL=1): the living AI enemies climb past the game's 165 and stay under about 350, and patrols keep coming. Today the game crashes past about 400 living enemies, so the spawn gate holds the count under 300.
